title: The conversation exam: written people, a simulated person, a blind judge, today's Home against Claude alone, and the sealed gate fixed first
request: The owner accepted the Phase 13 review (budget $35, store everything, judge Opus, person a third Claude model, a question ceiling, the thin slice) and said: start 37.0, the exam.
spec: Written dev people with hidden truths; a model plays each person from the truth only; arms today's Home and Claude alone on the same people; a judge blind to the arm scores understanding, questions, options and traps; code scores the route and safety; the gate for the sealed run 37.10 written before any run; the owner labels ten conversations a run; every conversation and model call kept for training, marked simulated.
plan: Record the owner's decisions and put the plan in the repository with a status table
Read the existing Home conversation eval and the gateway's purposes, prices and model override
Tests first: person, arms, judge, safety, score, gate, labels, refused runs, thinking kept
Build the package: people, person, arms, judge, gate, labels, runner; three prompts and purposes
Smoke runs on two and three people, then the full dev run
Review, fix, rerun the review, record, commit

decisions.decision: Claude alone sees exactly the table view Home's model sees (column names, kinds, what DCLab noticed), computed through Home's own upload path
decisions.why: the exam must compare the structure around Claude, not what each arm was allowed to see; a test asserts the two views are equal

decisions.decision: Claude alone gets two tools, offer_options and start_work, labelled with the six kinds of help
decisions.why: its route must be readable by code; the labels are vocabulary, not DCLab's flow

decisions.decision: The judge answers only facts (points understood, each question, fit, difference, trap); no reason field
decisions.why: the owner's rule: reasoning is read from the summarized API thinking, never asked for in the reply

decisions.decision: The person is Haiku 5.5, the judge Opus 5.5, both arms Sonnet 5.5
decisions.why: the owner's accepted decision: the judge differs from the agent, a third model plays the person

decisions.decision: Every number check follows cited.py's rule for every arm: digits nobody gave and code did not compute; words and whole numbers up to ten are no claim
decisions.why: the plan's deterministic table: every number shown to the person traced to data; the review showed number words and list markers flagged harmless text

decisions.decision: One stopping rule for both arms: a route is chosen and the last message asks nothing
decisions.why: the review found Claude alone stopped at its start while Home went on asking and earned credit for it

decisions.decision: A conversation the person, judge or budget broke is unjudged and must be rerun; only an arm's own failure scores against it
decisions.why: a judge's slip falls more often on the arm with more messages; a cap reached mid-run filled the rest with fake failures

decisions.decision: Option fit in the gate: an absolute bar (4 of 5 over at least 10 people shown options) plus the paired gain where both arms showed options to at least 10
decisions.why: Claude alone often starts work with no options, so a paired comparison alone could be empty and fail or pass by construction

decisions.decision: Exam exchanges carry an exam: draft id and are filed under their own stage, marked simulated; the judge's verdicts never teach the workflow LLM
decisions.why: the owner: keep everything for training, but simulation and judges never mixed with real people

decisions.decision: GATE_V1 was revised twice by the reviews before any measured run (smoke runs only)
decisions.why: a gate is fixed before the run that it judges; the smoke runs judged nothing

change: dclab_rnd.agent_eval.conversation_exam (new): people_dev.json (40 people written by a separate agent from the format alone, plus the owner's Telco session as a gold case), person (ModelPerson), arms (HomeArm through DraftWork.agent, PlainArm), judge (blind, checked shape, one retry), gate (GATE_V1 for 37.10, paired bootstrap, gap), labels (ten conversations blind for the owner, agreement), runner (play, safety, score, summarize, measure, Budget with a per-request cap, CLI refusing sealed and the case arm). Prompts exam_plain, exam_person, exam_judge; purposes in models.settings; agents.harness MODEL_USES; store.sets.llm: exam_judge and exam_person outside the workflow sets, exam: drafts under the exam_simulation stage and out of the reasoning sets. evidence/campaigns/conversation_exam_v1. docs/guides/PHASE13_CLAUDE_FIRST_PLAN.md with the owner's decisions and a status table. Workspace cap raised to EUR 150 (owner). Later the same day (the owner: every test's data and thinking kept for training): m7_judges/exam_judgments from the judge's calls (dclab-core 0.147.0: m7_judges may hold chat examples), exam calls named by their run, run ids never reused.

findings.defect: Claude alone's turn was cut at its start_work call
findings.scenario: CEX-001 d-36: the advice question got no answer; the judge saw an empty message
findings.cause: the plain arm ended its turn as soon as a tool showed options or started work
findings.fix: a turn ends only on a message to the person

findings.defect: An identifier was read as a number
findings.scenario: C-00012 in a reply counted as the uncited number -12
findings.cause: cited.numbers reads the dash and digits
findings.fix: identifier shapes are stripped before numbers are read, as Home's own check does

findings.defect: The safety check was unfair between the arms
findings.scenario: Home's allowed numbers were the whole draft (464 numbers, timestamps and its own card); Claude alone's only the column view; 'two things' and 'top 50' failed Claude alone
findings.cause: the draft dumped whole as a source, and number words counted
findings.fix: computed facts only (the table's analysis for both arms, the arm's computed outputs), digits only, whole numbers up to ten ignored

findings.defect: The Home arm was not today's Home
findings.scenario: Only the intent and understanding clients were passed; the advice answer took the no-model path
findings.cause: HomeAgent built by hand
findings.fix: DraftWork(store, budget view).agent(id), the product's wiring

findings.defect: The arms stopped by different rules
findings.scenario: Claude alone stopped at start_work with questions open; Home went on three turns and learned more
findings.cause: done meant different things per arm
findings.fix: one rule in play: a route and no question; a pick is answered by Claude too

findings.defect: Failed conversations dropped out of the averages
findings.scenario: An arm crashing on hard people was compared only on the rest
findings.cause: None scores skipped by the paired comparison
findings.fix: an arm's failure scores 0, the lowest fit and a failed trap; the gate's complete check

findings.defect: The owner's label file was not blind
findings.scenario: Entries alternated home, plain and only Home's had buttons
findings.cause: round-robin order and choice kinds kept
findings.fix: shuffled, choices stripped to title and what

findings.defect: The euro cap was not a hard cap
findings.scenario: Three live clients could each spend the whole remainder
findings.cause: a limit set once at creation
findings.fix: a proxy sets each client's limit before every request from what the run has left

findings.defect: Home's generic buttons were scored as options
findings.scenario: CEX-001 Home had options_fit 2 with no options shown
findings.cause: the judge's fit accepted without an option-kind choice
findings.fix: fit and difference null unless options were shown

findings.defect: Exam exchanges would mix with real Home work in the training sets
findings.scenario: exam_judge mapped to the report stage; the exam's home_understand calls unmarked
findings.cause: no mark for the exam's drafts
findings.fix: exam: draft ids, the exam_simulation stage marked simulated, kept out of the reasoning sets; exam_judge and exam_person outside the workflow sets

findings.defect: The gate's safety part was narrower than the plan's rubric
findings.scenario: No count for a build without a yes or an ignored guard
findings.cause: only numbers and records counted
findings.fix: both counted (zero for today's arms; 37.6 and 37.10 must wire them)

findings.defect: A judge's slip counted against the arm
findings.scenario: Opus merging two Home messages in one entry gave Home understanding 0
findings.cause: no retry, and every invalid judgment scored 0
findings.fix: the judge is asked once more; still invalid, the row is unjudged and the gate waits for a rerun

findings.defect: Reaching the cap filled the run with fake failures
findings.scenario: With the cap spent at person 20, people 21 to 41 scored 0 in both arms
findings.cause: the run went on after the budget refused
findings.fix: the run stops, the person in play is left out, the record says incomplete

findings.defect: The option-fit check could be empty
findings.scenario: Claude alone showed options to 0 of 2 people: the paired comparison had no rows
findings.cause: fit compared only where both arms showed options
findings.fix: an absolute bar for the lead plus the paired gain where at least 10 pairs exist

findings.defect: A run stopped early left its folder unmarked as simulated
findings.scenario: The stopped full run's folders could be read as real people's picks
findings.cause: the markers were written after the loop
findings.fix: WHY.md and scripted.json written before the first conversation

findings.defect: Home's offer was shown twice
findings.scenario: CEX-003 owner-telco: every option title appeared again as a button
findings.cause: the offer's titles come back among the question's buttons
findings.fix: a button with an option's title is shown once

findings.defect: Today's Home loops on the prediction moment after the person refuses prediction (left for Phase 13)
findings.scenario: CEX-003 owner-telco: 'groups only, no predictions' confirmed three times, the switch to describing data failed, the same question asked four times
findings.cause: the track switch to analysis did not take, and the prediction brief's question stayed pending
findings.fix: not fixed in 37.0, which measures; the lead agent (37.3, 37.4) owns the conversation

findings.defect: Some code-written Home messages are their own number source
findings.scenario: A message of kind answer or brief is allowed as a source while its own words are checked
findings.cause: the source list takes code-written message kinds
findings.fix: kept: those numbers already pass cited.py against Home's records; noted for 37.6

findings.defect: A smoke run reused the id of the stopped run and overwrote two of its conversations
findings.scenario: The stopped full run kept its folder as CEX-003 with no result file; the next smoke run took CEX-003 again and replaced d-02's two conversation files (their model calls stay in the exchange log)
findings.cause: next_id read only stored results
findings.fix: next_id reads the kept folders too

findings.defect: The judge's verdicts were stored but taught no model
findings.scenario: 64 exam_judge calls kept whole with Opus's summarized thinking, read by no training set
findings.cause: m7_judges took only scored items; no builder read judge calls
findings.fix: m7_judges/exam_judgments: each judge call as a chat lesson (the case in, the verdict out, the summarized thinking as the reasoning), silver at half weight; dclab-core 0.147.0 lets m7_judges hold chat examples

findings.defect: Two runs' calls on the same person shared one draft id
findings.scenario: exam:home-d-02 named the calls of CEX-003 and of the stopped run alike, told apart only by time
findings.cause: exam keys had no run id
findings.fix: every exam call's draft id names its run (exam:CEX-NNN:...)

measurements.name: CEX-004, the conversation exam on dev (41 people: 40 written, the owner's Telco session)
measurements.gate: none for 37.0: it measures the gap; conversation_exam_gate_v1 judges 37.10 only
measurements.result: understanding of the points: today's Home 0.50, Claude alone 0.50 (paired difference -0.004, 90% interval -0.10 to 0.09); right route: Home 80%, Claude alone 76%; options shown: Home 7 of 41, Claude alone 13 of 41, fit about 3 of 5 for both; questions useful: Home 56%, Claude alone 84%; questions already answered: Home 51, Claude alone 4; traps: Claude alone better on clear requests (5/6 vs 2/6), missing columns (3/3 vs 1/3) and reports that are predictions (2/2 vs 0/2), Home better on a silent drop (1/1 vs 0/1) and vague goals (2/3 vs 0/3); both missed both real-prediction traps; numbers no one gave: Home 3, Claude alone 10 (about 1 and 9 after the 200k reading fix, most of Claude alone's illustrative numbers in advice answers); no silent turn, no failure, no unjudged conversation
limits: written, simulated people: real sessions are what it needs most
the judge is checked against the owner's ten labels only once they are given
the stored result keeps the number check as it ran (the 200k reading was fixed after)

measurements.name: smoke runs CEX-001 to CEX-003 and the stopped run
measurements.gate: none: smoke runs to check the exam itself
measurements.result: found the cut Claude-alone turn, the unfair number sources, the Home wiring and the stopping rule; kept as data

outcome: The exam exists and measured the gap on dev: today's Home and Claude alone understand the same share of what a good listener would (about half), Home routes a little better but asks many questions already answered, Claude alone asks better questions but acts at once and states illustrative numbers; neither writes options that fit the person (about 3 of 5). Phase 13's lead agent must beat both on understanding, the one place neither is good. The gate for the sealed run is fixed; the owner's ten labels wait in the labelling page.
lessons: An exam's fairness is code: the same view, the same stopping rule and the same number rule for every arm, each pinned by a test
A failure has an owner: the arm's counts against it, the person's, the judge's or the budget's is rerun
Read the transcripts of a smoke run before trusting its numbers: the first one showed an arm cut mid-turn
risks: The judge is one Claude model judging Claude: its agreement with the owner's labels is the check
The people are written; real sessions are what the exam needs most
The strict number rule fails illustrative numbers in an advice answer, as Home's own cited.py does
